extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale dataset of robotic failures comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu; Minghao Ye; Zewei Ye; Ruihan Tao; Shuo Yang; Bo Zhao
extraction.citeAs: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao. RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction. 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Simulation data was collected in the ManiSkill environment by defining expert policies and replacing them with code snippets to generate erroneous trajectories. Real-world data was collected via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: During data collection, motion planning for the robotic arm occasionally failed, resulting in trajectories that did not align with the corresponding textual descriptions. Approximately 25% of the collected data was discarded during manual data cleaning, retaining about 75% of the data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Simulation data was sourced from the ManiSkill environment, augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. Real-world data consists of teleoperation videos using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Reference answers for five question types were directly extracted from textual descriptions, while the remaining three types utilized both the video and its corresponding textual description as inputs to GPT-4o to generate the reference answers. All outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Our current integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless; we apply our model exclusively to the VLA model in this work; the VLA model's limited ability to follow complex natural language instructions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training multimodal large models for robotic task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction; evaluating multimodal models' capabilities in robotic failure video understanding.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: To generate failure data, we replace the original expert policy with a code snippet that generates an erroneous trajectory at the selected substage, causing the overall robotic task to fail.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We manually performed thorough data cleaning and retained approximately 75% of the collected data.
